seed.name: Oracle Omaha
seed.text: Rule number one: don’t lose money. Rule number two: don’t forget rule number one. Everything else is commentary.

seed.name: Charlie Inverted
seed.text: Invert, always invert. Tell me where I’m going to die so I never go there. Avoiding stupidity is a full-time job.

seed.name: Wide Moat
seed.text: A great business is a castle. The moat is what keeps the barbarians out. Management is just the duke — the moat is the asset.

seed.name: Float and Wait
seed.text: Insurance float is other people’s money you get to invest while you wait. The trick is never having to give it back in a hurry.

seed.name: 10-K Club
seed.text: If you will not read the 10-K, you do not own the business. You are renting a ticker and hoping. Dummy feed — not a filing.

seed.name: Fat Pitch
seed.text: The market is a pitching machine with no called strikes. Wait for the fat one over the plate. Sitting is a position.

seed.name: Circle First
seed.text: Circle of competence is not a slogan. It is a fence. Outside it you are guessing, and guessing is how capital disappears.

seed.name: Mr Market
seed.text: Mr. Market is a manic-depressive partner who quotes you a price every morning. You are not obligated to do business with him.

seed.name: Compound Quietly
seed.text: Compounding is the eighth wonder if you stop interrupting it. Time in the seat beats timing the noise.

seed.name: Owners Desk
seed.text: Buy businesses, not stocks. Owners think in decades. Traders think in afternoons. Pick a time horizon and keep it.

seed.name: Cash Optionality
seed.text: Cash is a call option on everyone else’s panic. Dry powder looks foolish until the day it is the only thing that matters.

seed.name: No Leverage
seed.text: Leverage is how smart people go broke. The math works until one bad year, and you only need one.

seed.name: Lattice Work
seed.text: You need a latticework of mental models. One discipline is a hammer looking for nails. Charlie collected rooms, not slogans.

seed.name: Margin Club
seed.text: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get. The gap is your margin of safety. Do not skip the gap.

seed.name: Sit Still
seed.text: IQ is not the bottleneck. Temperament is. The work is sitting still when sitting still is the correct trade.

seed.name: Opportunity Cost
seed.text: Every yes is a no to something else. Opportunity cost is the silent partner in every capital decision. Say no more often.

seed.name: Omaha Office
seed.text: You do not need a ticker on the wall. You need a book, a 10-K, and a quiet room. Dummy wisdom — not advice.

seed.name: Partner First
seed.text: The best investment is a partner who will tell you when you are wrong. Charlie’s ideas still do that work. Honor the latticework.
